level1.text: At a petrol station, $2.0\,\text{kg}$ of petrol was bought for a chainsaw. The heat of combustion of petrol is $43\,\tfrac{\text{MJ}}{\text{kg}}$. How much energy is released when the petrol burns? Give the answer in megajoules.

On a winter day, $2.0\,\text{kg}$ of natural gas is burnt in a gas boiler. Read the heat of combustion of natural gas from the bar chart in the figure. How much energy is released from the gas? Give the answer in megajoules.

A coal-fired power plant burns $12\,000\,\text{kg}$ of coal per hour, with a heat of combustion of $26\,\tfrac{\text{MJ}}{\text{kg}}$. How much energy is released from the coal in an hour? Give the answer in megajoules.

$400\,\text{kg}$ of milled peat with a heat of combustion of $10\,\tfrac{\text{MJ}}{\text{kg}}$ is taken from the storage of a heating plant to be burnt. How much energy is released from the peat? Give the answer in megajoules.

The energy content of a hiker's nut mix is $24\,\tfrac{\text{MJ}}{\text{kg}}$ (example value). A handful of nuts weighs $0.040\,\text{kg}$. How much energy do you get from the handful? Give the answer in megajoules.

level2.text: The nutritional label on a loaf of bread (example) says: energy $1200\,\text{kJ}$ per hundred grams. A slice of bread weighs $40\,\text{g}$. How much energy is in the slice? Give the answer in kilojoules.

A diesel generator on a building site must release $1.8\,\text{GJ}$ of energy from fuel. The heat of combustion of diesel is $43\,\tfrac{\text{MJ}}{\text{kg}}$. How many kilograms of diesel must be burnt? Give the answer in kilograms.

In the pellet burner of a detached house, $40\,\text{kg}$ of wood pellets with a heat of combustion of $17\,\tfrac{\text{MJ}}{\text{kg}}$ are burnt. The efficiency of the boiler is $85\,\%$. How much useful energy is obtained from the pellets to heat the house? Give the answer in megajoules.

A passenger car needs $48\,\text{MJ}$ of useful energy to drive $100\,\text{km}$. The efficiency of the engine is $25\,\%$. The heat of combustion of petrol is $43\,\tfrac{\text{MJ}}{\text{kg}}$. How many kilograms of petrol are used on a $100\,\text{km}$ journey? Give the answer in kilograms.

level3.text: To heat a cottage, $120\,\text{MJ}$ of energy must be released from fuel. The energy can be obtained either from air-dried firewood ($15\,\tfrac{\text{MJ}}{\text{kg}}$) or from light heating oil ($43\,\tfrac{\text{MJ}}{\text{kg}}$). Calculate the mass of each fuel needed and say how many kilograms more wood than oil are needed. Also explain why more wood is needed. Give the answer in kilograms.

A hiker carries food with an energy content of $18\,\tfrac{\text{MJ}}{\text{kg}}$ (example value). There is $2.4\,\text{kg}$ of food, and the hiker needs $12\,\text{MJ}$ of energy from food per day. How many daily rations does the food provide? Give the answer as a decimal number and justify your calculation.

A peat-fired power plant burns $36\,\text{t}$ of milled peat per hour, with a heat of combustion of $10\,\tfrac{\text{MJ}}{\text{kg}}$. The efficiency of the plant in electricity production is $35\,\%$. What is the electric power of the power plant? Give the answer in megawatts. Remember: $1\,\text{W} = 1\,\text{J/s}$ and one hour is $3600\,\text{s}$.
